periods.label: Sat 19 Sep
periods.text: Northwest to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots tending northwest to southwesterly in the evening then tending east to southeasterly in the late evening. Below 1 metre. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres offshore north of Moruya Heads. Mostly sunny.
